Screens & details

Dates & sources

The portfolio repository starts on 9 May 2018; its animation and responsive-layout commits continue into July. The later snapshot is dated November 2023.

I was working as a web and blockchain consultant when I made this edition of my portfolio. I used project mockups and animated transitions to show the client work.

I’ve restored both editions so you can browse them again. The 2018 version includes the original client-work layouts; the later snapshot preserves the design I was using in November 2023.
